description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two different text-to-SQL generation systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories of query complexity: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis represents the categories, while the vertical axis indicates the execution accuracy, measured in percentage. The chart uses two shades of blue to differentiate between the two systems, with NatSQL represented by a lighter blue and TA-SQL by a darker blue. For Simple queries, NatSQL has an execution accuracy of 60.21%, while TA-SQL has a slightly higher accuracy of 63.14%. In the Moderate category, NatSQL's accuracy is 39.64%, and TA-SQL's is 48.60%. For Challenging queries, NatSQL's accuracy drops to 32.32%, and TA-SQL's is 36.11%. The Total category shows NatSQL with an accuracy of 51.35% and TA-SQL with 56.19%. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars, and no additional annotations or visual effects are present.
